class FuzzerAffixManager {
 public:
  FuzzerAffixManager(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    if (size < 1)
      return;
    std::string aff(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
    std::string dic;
    size_t split_at = aff.find('\n');
    if (split_at != std::string::npos) {
      dic = aff.substr(split_at + 1);
      aff.resize(split_at);
    }
    // aff and dic must be null-terminated
    aff.push_back('\0');
    dic.push_back('\0');
    pMS = Hunspell_create(&aff[0], &dic[0]);
  }
  ~FuzzerAffixManager() {
    if (pMS)
      Hunspell_destroy(pMS);
  }
  Hunspell* pMS = nullptr;
};

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
  if (size < 1)
    return 0;
  std::string all(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
  size_t wordlen = all[0];
  if (wordlen + 1 >= size)
    return 0;
  std::string word = all.substr(1, wordlen);
  std::string rest = all.substr(1 + wordlen);
  size_t split_at = rest.size() / 2;
  std::string aff = rest.substr(0, split_at);
  std::string dic = rest.substr(split_at);

  FuzzerAffixManager manager(aff.data(), aff.size());
  if (!manager.pMS)
    return 0;

  Hunspell_spell(manager.pMS, word.c_str());
  std::vector<std::string> suggestions;
  Hunspell_suggest(manager.pMS, suggestions, word.c_str());
  return 0;
}

Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The aff data is passed to `FuzzerAffixManager` which splits it at the first newline. So the aff data format is:

- Rest: dic content

Wait, no. Looking at the fuzzer code again:

```cpp
FuzzerAffixManager manager(aff.data(), aff.size());
```

And in `FuzzerAffixManager`:
```cpp
std::string aff(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
std::string dic;
size_t split_at = aff.find('\n');
if (split_at != std::string::npos) {
    dic = aff.substr(split_at + 1);
    aff.resize(split_at);
}
```

So the aff data passed to `FuzzerAffixManager` is split at the first newline. The part before the newline is the aff content, and the part after is the dic content.

But wait, in the main fuzzer function, the rest is split in half:
```cpp
size_t split_at = rest.size() / 2;
std::string aff = rest.substr(0, split_at);
std::string dic = rest.substr(split_at);
```

So `aff` and `dic` are separate strings. Then `FuzzerAffixManager` is called with `aff.data()` and `aff.size()`. Inside `FuzzerAffixManager`, it splits `aff` at the first newline. So the aff data I provide should have the aff content followed by a newline and then the dic content.

Wait, that's confusing. Let me re-read:

```cpp
FuzzerAffixManager manager(aff.data(), aff.size());
```

`aff` is the first half of the rest. Inside `FuzzerAffixManager`:
```cpp
std::string aff(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
std::string dic;
size_t split_at = aff.find('\n');
if (split_at != std::string::npos) {
    dic = aff.substr(split_at + 1);
    aff.resize(split_at);
}
```

So the `aff` string passed to `FuzzerAffixManager` is split at the first newline. The part before the newline becomes the aff content, and the part after becomes the dic content.

But then in the main fuzzer, `dic` (the second half of rest) is never used! The `FuzzerAffixManager` creates its own dic from the aff data.

So the actual format is:
- Byte 0: word length
- Bytes 1..wordlen: word
- Rest: split in half
  - First half: aff data (which contains aff content, newline, dic content)
  - Second half: unused

So I need to put both aff and dic content in the first half, separated by a newline.

Let me construct:
- Aff content: "SET UTF-8\nTRY \xF0\x80\x80\x80\n"
- Dic content: "1\ntest\n"
- Combined: "SET UTF-8\nTRY \xF0\x80\x80\x80\n1\ntest\n"

This is 34 bytes. The first half of rest should be at least this long. Let me make the rest 68 bytes so the first half is 34 bytes.

Actually, let me just make the rest exactly 34 bytes, split at 17. Then the first half is 17 bytes: "SET UTF-8\nTRY \xF0" - that's not enough.

I need the first half to contain the full aff and dic content. So the rest needs to be at least 68 bytes (34*2). Let me pad the second half with zeros.

Let me construct the PoC:
- Word: "xyz" (3 bytes)
- First byte: 3
- Rest: 68 bytes
  - First 34 bytes: "SET UTF-8\nTRY \xF0\x80\x80\x80\n1\ntest\n"
  - Last 34 bytes: padding (zeros)

Total file size: 4 + 68 = 72 bytes

class FuzzerAffixManager {
 public:
  FuzzerAffixManager(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    if (size < 1)
      return;
    std::string aff(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
    std::string dic;
    size_t split_at = aff.find('\n');
    if (split_at != std::string::npos) {
      dic = aff.substr(split_at + 1);
      aff.resize(split_at);
    }
    // aff and dic must be null-terminated
    aff.push_back('\0');
    dic.push_back('\0');
    pMS = Hunspell_create(&aff[0], &dic[0]);
  }
  ~FuzzerAffixManager() {
    if (pMS)
      Hunspell_destroy(pMS);
  }
  Hunspell* pMS = nullptr;
};

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
  if (size < 1)
    return 0;
  std::string all(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), size);
  size_t wordlen = all[0];
  if (wordlen + 1 >= size)
    return 0;
  std::string word = all.substr(1, wordlen);
  std::string rest = all.substr(1 + wordlen);
  size_t split_at = rest.size() / 2;
  std::string aff = rest.substr(0, split_at);
  std::string dic = rest.substr(split_at);

  FuzzerAffixManager manager(aff.data(), aff.size());
  if (!manager.pMS)
    return 0;

  Hunspell_spell(manager.pMS, word.c_str());
  std::vector<std::string> suggestions;
  Hunspell_suggest(manager.pMS, suggestions, word.c_str());
  return 0;
}
